result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`, and the new and existing tests in `codeanalyzer` pass.

Changes in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match.
- **.NET assembly docs:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]xml` instead of `.*/[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` content check still limits it to real documentation files.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …`:** the path pattern is now `.*[.]js` instead of `.*/[.]js`, so `app.js` matches. The content check still keeps hand-written `.js` files out.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the pattern is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js` instead of `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks that the fixed files land in the right scope, that the previously matched cases still match, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out. It passes along with `SourceFileFilterTest`, run offline with `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test`. I did not confirm that the new test fails on the old patterns.

Nothing is committed.
